author: 0w3n6325
content:
Currently the plan is for the relay to be the in protocol builder with off chain builders submitting to us. So only a single id.

That's the most straight forward approach for us as it is very close to what we currently do.

But we will also likely support on chain builders signing their own bids and sending them to us. In which case we really are just relaying their bids.

But we haven't explored implementing that yet. Nor have we implemented the trustless payments yet but again, that's not to say we won't. The initial goal was just to ensure we can continue to operate as normal.
